title: Cape Buffalo: The Underestimated Member of the Big Five
excerpt: The Cape buffalo is the most underestimated member of the Big Five. Facts about herds, old bulls and behaviour.
body:
## Herds

Buffaloes live in herds that can number hundreds of animals.

## Old bulls

Old males often leave the herd and live alone or in small groups. Locally they are sometimes called "dagga boys", after the mud they wallow in.

## Dangerous

Buffaloes are unpredictable. That is why they are part of the [Big Five](/blog/big-five-explained/).

## Predators

Lions hunt buffaloes, but it is risky. Herds defend each other.

## Where

Almost all parks in Tanzania, especially Katavi, Ngorongoro and the Serengeti.

## Oxpeckers

Birds that sit on buffaloes eating ticks.
